assets.title: Ribbed Dome Warning Beacon
assets.description: One original low fixed beacon appearance, counted as one static visual prop. A broad closed installation disc has three genuine full-thickness mounting holes and a complete planar underside. A thick open annular collar rests on the disc and supports the entire lower rim of a single integral closed-top dome shell. Twelve modeled longitudinal ridges are continuously part of its shared-vertex outer skin; an actual thick blind interior cavity remains inside, hidden after the base closes the assembly. Three closed editable component meshes, three opaque constant PBR materials, metre units, source Z up, front -Y, horizontal centre and mounting underside Z=0. No interior rotor, lens insert, glass, emission, textures, separate intersecting rib strips, imported old lamp, cables, vehicle, attachment bolts or scene. Static unlit illustrative geometry only: no rotating/flashing operation, brightness, optical coverage, warning or firefighting standard, electrical function, sealing, ingress protection, mounting compatibility, vehicle fit, material/manufacturing or public-safety performance claim.
